planets.name: Kepler-446 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-446 with a 1.57-day year, found in 2015.

text.card: Kepler-446 b was found in 2015 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around Kepler-446. Its orbit and size follow Muirhead et al. 2015's fit, the archive's default.
